-- Progress -- [AP7:auto-Timeline-lua-3]
	local function draw_progress()
		-- [AP9: pretty progress] rounded pill: glassy track, glowing gradient fill with a soft highlight, a shine sliding over it while
		-- playing, and a round knob with a pulsing halo that grows when the bar is hovered. Everything follows the theme / accent.
		local sc = state.scale
		local th = math.max(3 * sc, math.min(size * 0.38, 8 * sc))      -- thickness: thin when idle, thicker while hovered
		local r = th / 2
		local ty1, ty2 = fcy - r, fcy + r
		local ex1, ex2 = bax + r, bbx - r
		local px = clamp(ex1, bax + self.width * progress, ex2)
		local vis = math.max(visibility, 0)
		local now = mp.get_time()
		local function tint(c, f)   -- c = 'bbggrr', f = 0..1 towards white
			local b, g, rr = tonumber(c:sub(1, 2), 16), tonumber(c:sub(3, 4), 16), tonumber(c:sub(5, 6), 16)
			local function m(v) return math.floor(v + (255 - v) * f) end
			return string.format('%02x%02x%02x', m(b), m(g), m(rr))
		end
		-- track: dark glass with a light rim
		ass:rect(ex1 - r, ty1, ex2 + r, ty2, {color = bg, opacity = 0.55, radius = r})
		ass:rect(ex1 - r, ty1, ex2 + r, ty2, {color = bgt, opacity = 0.10 + 0.08 * vis, radius = r})
		local played_ax, played_bx = ex1 - r, math.max(px, ex1)
		-- glow under the played part
		ass:new_event()
		ass:append('{\\rDefault\\an7\\blur' .. round(th * 1.1) .. '\\bord0\\1c&H' .. fg .. '}')
		ass:opacity(0.30 + 0.30 * vis)
		ass:pos(0, 0)
		ass:draw_start()
		ass:round_rect_cw(played_ax, ty1, played_bx, ty2, r)
		ass:draw_stop()
		-- played part: base colour, then lighter slices towards the knob (a gradient), then a highlight on the top half
		ass:rect(played_ax, ty1, played_bx, ty2, {color = fg, radius = r, opacity = config.opacity.position})
		local slices = 32
		local span = played_bx - (ex1 + r)
		if span > slices * 2 then
			for k = 1, slices - 1 do
				local sx1 = ex1 + r + span * k / slices
				local sx2 = ex1 + r + span * (k + 1) / slices
				ass:rect(sx1, ty1, sx2 + 0.5, ty2, {color = tint(fg, 0.26 * k / slices + (state.pause and 0.04 or 0.09 * (0.5 + 0.5 * math.sin(now * 2.2 - k * 0.22)))), opacity = config.opacity.position})  -- [AP14: flowing gradient]
			end
		end
		if played_bx - played_ax > 2 * r then
			ass:rect(played_ax + r * 0.6, ty1 + th * 0.12, played_bx - r * 0.3, ty1 + th * 0.42, {color = 'ffffff', radius = th * 0.15, opacity = 0.22})
		end
		-- [AP15: hover preview] while the mouse is on the bar, the part between the knob and the cursor lights up softly
		if vis > 0.2 and self.proximity_raw <= 0 and cursor.x and cursor.x > px + 2 then
			ass:rect(px, ty1, clamp(px, cursor.x, ex2 + r), ty2, {color = tint(fg, 0.5), opacity = 0.28 * vis, radius = r})
		end

		-- [AP16: soft trail] a smooth glow that fades out behind the knob (three blurred layers, no hard edges); it breathes while playing
		local played_w = played_bx - played_ax
		if played_w > 8 * sc then
			local breathe = state.pause and 0 or math.sin(now * 2.0)
			local tail = math.min(played_w - r, (70 + 24 * breathe) * sc * (0.55 + 0.75 * vis))
			local layers = {{1.0, 0.16}, {0.62, 0.20}, {0.30, 0.26}}
			for _, ly in ipairs(layers) do
				local len = tail * ly[1]
				ass:new_event()
				ass:append('{\\rDefault\\an7\\blur' .. round(th * 0.9) .. '\\bord0\\1c&H' .. tint(fg, 0.55) .. '&\\clip(' .. round(played_ax) .. ',' .. round(ty1 - th) .. ',' .. round(px) .. ',' .. round(ty2 + th) .. ')}')
				ass:opacity(ly[2] * (state.pause and 0.5 or 1) * (0.5 + 0.5 * vis))
				ass:pos(0, 0)
				ass:draw_start()
				ass:round_rect_cw(px - len, ty1 + th * 0.1, px + r, ty2 - th * 0.1, r * 0.8)
				ass:draw_stop()
			end
			if not state.pause and vis > 0 then request_render() end
		end
		-- knob: pulsing halo + white ball with an accent rim
		local kr = r * (1.0 + 0.9 * vis)
		local pulse = state.pause and 0 or math.sin(now * 3.2)
		local halo = kr * (1.9 + 0.3 * pulse)
		ass:new_event()
		ass:append('{\\rDefault\\an7\\blur' .. round(halo * 0.6) .. '\\bord0\\1c&H' .. fg .. '}')
		ass:opacity((0.22 + 0.25 * vis) * (state.pause and 0.6 or 1))
		ass:pos(0, 0)
		ass:draw_start()
		ass:round_rect_cw(px - halo, fcy - halo, px + halo, fcy + halo, halo)
		ass:draw_stop()
		ass:circle(px, fcy, kr, {color = 'ffffff', opacity = 0.95 * math.max(vis, 0.35), border = math.max(1, round(sc * (0.5 + 1.5 * vis))), border_color = fg})
	end
